prompts.fallen_log: Use case: stylized-concept. One complete transparent game sprite of a fallen tree trunk obstructing a rural Korean dirt path. Reference image 1 sets palette and pixel art style only. 3/4 top-down orthographic 2D JRPG view, NOT isometric. Final logical canvas 48x48 native pixels. Single hefty horizontal oak/pine log runs slightly diagonally left-to-right across most width, full intact object within canvas; a clear pale circular cut/broken end on right, 2 broad bark grooves, one snapped branch stub upward and another small broken branch downward so it occupies a square footprint. No leafy crown, no pile, no surrounding scenery, no ground patch, no separate stones, no dropshadow outside body. Strong chestnut dark outline, 2-3 flat brown shades, clean large pixel clusters like team's Venice market artwork, very sparse texture. Recognizable at 48x48; no noisy grain or realistic shading, no lettering, no figures. True transparent background with narrow even margin, sprite occupies about 44x36 logical pixels.
prompts.transit_spice: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE very simple transparent inventory item icon for a Korean/cross-cultural fantasy trading game: an open little tan cloth spice pouch with a reddish-orange heap of ground spice visible at the top, short tied cord at the neck/front. Reference image 1 gives the actual game's tiny 16x16 icons and colors. Reference image 2 gives style only. Final icon must read at 16x16 native pixels, use about 12x13 logical pixels plus transparent margin. Strong dark brown 1 logical pixel outline, 2-3 flat ochre cloth shades, one large vivid russet-red spice color plane, cream cord. Simple front/top-down view, large readable silhouette, NOT a realistic illustration, no tiny individual seeds, no bowls, no spoon, no label, no text, no background or shadow. Entire single pouch, no detached accessories. Chunky pixel art with no antialiasing, no gradients, minimal detail.
prompts.transit_wool: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE very simple transparent inventory icon for a cute pixel fantasy trade game: a compact bundle of raw cream-colored wool tied firmly around the middle with one warm brown cord. Reference image 1 gives the actual game's 16x16 item icons. Reference image 2 style only. Final native 16x16 pixels, about 13x12 logical pixels object plus transparent margin. Readable plump off-white wool silhouette with three or four large rounded lobes, ONE obvious brown binding crossing around center; no intricate fibers or individual strands, no ball-of-yarn spiral, no knitted fabric, no sheep face, no basket. Dark warm brown pixel outline, cream/ivory/light tan 2-3 flat shade planes, clean big chunks. Front/top-down JRPG icon, no isometric angle. All object fits; true transparent background, no lettering/no ground shadow.
prompts.river_flood_high: Use case: stylized-concept. Design ONE terrain OVERLAY MODULE for a 2D top-down pixel game, final canvas 80x48 pixels (5 by 3 ground tiles). It represents a river overflowing LEFTWARD onto an existing grassy dirt path. It must CONNECT to a large river along the RIGHT BORDER, never look like an isolated oval pond. Reference 1 is the team's flat-color pixel art style. Orthographic overhead 2D terrain, no perspective or raised walls. Water main flat jade RGB #7FB9AF. Along the entire rightmost border the image is solid flat jade from top to bottom and runs exactly to the edge, no dark outline there, no grass bank on right. Water stretches across canvas to the left in two or three broad organic lobes of different length with a few shallow irregular corners, not a rectangle and not an oval. Left/bottom/top exposed banks have a very narrow muted dark jade water lip and a few pale mint short ripples near the center, no thick foamy white ring, no shoreline rocks or vegetation. Outside the lobe is TRUE TRANSPARENT so original grass and dirt remain visible. Use at most 4 water colors, large simple flat areas, sparse detail, no dithering/gradients, no realistic waves, no drop shadow. Exact intended 5:3 aspect ratio. SINGLE connecting overlay only, no labels/frames/comparison.
